inputScope: No hints, references, accepted keys or model supplied. Text only; no human acoustic audit.

items.material: There is a lamp in the room. The lamp is under the table. There is a cup on the table.
items.prompt: 你要找lamp。听完选一条位置确认，只写A/B/C：A on the table；B under the table；C in the cup。

items.material: There is a box under the desk. There is a camera in the box. The lamp is on the desk.
items.prompt: 相机应从哪里找？按材料选直接位置，只写A/B/C：A on the desk；B in the box；C on the lamp。

items.material: There is a cupboard near the door. There is a knife in the cupboard. The clean cup is on the table.
items.prompt: 要取knife，应确认哪个直接位置？只写A/B/C：A on the table；B near the cup；C in the cupboard。

items.material: Jo: Is the bottle on the table? Rae: No. It is in the cupboard. The cup is on the table.
items.prompt: 已明确it指bottle。核对留言中的瓶子位置，只写A/B/C：A in the cupboard；B on the table；C under the table。

items.material: There is a large box on the shelf. There is a clean cup in the box. The dirty cup is under the table.
items.prompt: 你需要clean cup。按材料选它的直接位置，不选容器所在位置，只写A/B/C：A under the table；B on the shelf；C in the box。

items.material:
餐具便签
There are some plates on the table. They are clean.
There are some cups in the cupboard. They are dirty.
items.prompt: 要取干净的餐具，应选哪条领物信息？只写A/B/C：A dirty cups in the cupboard；B clean plates on the table；C clean cups on the table。

items.material:
工具间便签
There are some maps on the wall.
There are some boxes near the door. The tools are in the boxes. They are clean.
items.prompt: 伙伴需要tools，不是外面的boxes或墙上的maps。哪条确认与便签一致？只写A/B/C：A tools on the wall；B tools near the window；C tools in the boxes。

items.material:
展览准备便签
There are some bottles on the shelf.
There are some boxes near the window. The maps are in the boxes. They are old.
items.prompt: 伙伴需要maps，不是bottles或外面的boxes。哪条确认与便签一致？只写A/B/C：A maps in the boxes；B maps on the shelf；C maps on the window。

items.material:
数量未点清的库存便签
There are some cups in the cupboard. They are clean.
There are some bottles on the table.
items.prompt: 不能猜未写的数量。哪条库存说明被便签直接支持？只写A/B/C：A exactly two clean cups in the cupboard（恰好两个）；B some clean cups in the cupboard（若干）；C some clean bottles in the cupboard。

items.material:
等候区便签
There are some chairs near the window.
The boxes are under the table. The tickets are in the boxes. They are green.
items.prompt: 为了领green tickets，哪条位置确认正确？只写A/B/C：A tickets near the window；B tickets on the table；C tickets in the boxes。

items.material: 你把一个装书任务交给面前的伙伴。明确规则是先打开空盒子，再把书放进这个盒子。没有其他规定。
items.prompt: 口头说2句，先说明伙伴必须做的第一步，再给出第二步指令。让对方听清对象和先后，可以礼貌表达。

items.material: 你在入口向接手整理工作的伙伴说明规则：他/她先脱下自己的外套，再把同一件外套放进橱柜。橱柜不是装地图的盒子；不用关窗。
items.prompt: 口头说2句交接：第一句说明必须先做的动作；第二句指明同一件物品的下一步与正确位置。不要增加无关任务。

items.material: 你在收件台向接手整理工作的伙伴说明规则：他/她先读这封信（letter），再把同一封信放进盒子。信不放进橱柜；不用清理桌子。
items.prompt: 换一个情境口头说2句交接：说明必须先做的动作，再指明同一件物品的下一步与正确容器，不增加无关任务。

items.material: 你向清理房间的接手人交接已确认规则：先关窗，再扫地。盒子可以保持原样，任务没有要求打开它。
items.prompt: 口头说2句，让接手人听清必须先完成什么，再给下一步指令。不要把没规定的盒子任务加进去。

items.material: 任务表：Ava负责打开窗；Ben负责清理桌子。你向协调员报告分工，然后当面对Ben给出他自己的指令。题设没有规定两人的先后，也没有性别信息。
items.prompt: 口头说3句：先明确每人的必须任务，再向Ben给出直接指令。别交换分工或编造先后。
